policy: Only sources with an explicit permissive repository license are fetchable from this registry. Brand and university marks may have separate usage restrictions.

templates.name: Beautiful HTML Templates
templates.best_for: General business, editorial, creative, and product HTML decks
templates.entrypoint: Read AGENTS.md and select from templates/*/metadata.json or index.json

templates.name: AI Slide Templates
templates.best_for: Business, research, training, education, nonprofit, real-estate, travel, and executive decks
templates.entrypoint: Read AGENTS.md and scan templates/*/template.json

templates.name: Inspiration Deck Workshop
templates.best_for: Fast proposals, launches, research briefs, workshops, reports, and social decks
templates.entrypoint: Run node tools/cli.mjs new <name> --template <template> --theme <theme> only after inspecting the repository

templates.name: Marp Slides Studio
templates.best_for: Markdown-first talks, technical presentations, training, and version-controlled decks
features: Reusable cover, metric, comparison, flow, screenshot, and code layouts
HTML, PDF, PPTX, and PNG export
templates.entrypoint: Inspect template/slides.md and themes; run npm commands only after repository review

templates.name: CUHK Slides Template
templates.best_for: Authorized CUHK-themed academic talks and university presentations
templates.entrypoint: Inspect cuhk-template.html and the skills/md-to-cuhk-slides workflow
templates.brand_notice: Confirm authorization before using institutional logos or implying endorsement.

templates.name: Fudan HTML PPT Template
templates.best_for: Authorized Fudan-themed academic presentations
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the repository SKILL.md and template files before adapting
templates.brand_notice: Confirm authorization before using institutional logos or implying endorsement.

templates.name: PPTX from Layouts
templates.best_for: Generating editable decks from real PowerPoint slide-master layouts
features: Maps semantic content to named layouts
templates.entrypoint: Follow the pptx-profile, pptx-author, and pptx-from-layouts pipeline

templates.name: PPTX Template Skills
templates.best_for: Parsing a user-supplied PowerPoint template into a reusable semantic contract
templates.entrypoint: Parse template.pptx to spec.json, validate content_plan.json, then apply it

templates.name: Competition PPT Template-First Skill
templates.best_for: Competition, defense, product, and technical decks requiring strong art direction and editable evidence layers
templates.entrypoint: Read skills/competition-ppt-template-first/SKILL.md and its workflow references

templates.name: PPT Master Example Gallery
templates.best_for: Studying editable PPTX composition patterns and starting from a custom template workflow
features: Native shapes, charts, tables, notes, transitions, and animations
templates.entrypoint: Inspect examples and documentation; reuse design principles rather than copying example content

templates.name: DeckMason
templates.best_for: General-purpose HTML presentations with selectable visual themes
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the theme catalog and repository instructions before selecting a theme

templates.name: Neko Slidev Template
templates.best_for: Developer talks and playful Slidev presentations using a Neko visual style
features: Browser presentation and export support through Slidev
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the template package and Slidev configuration before adapting it

templates.name: NeoBeam
templates.best_for: Modern Markdown-first presentations using a focused Marp theme
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the theme CSS and example Markdown before use

templates.name: MarpX
templates.best_for: Markdown presentations needing a broad choice of named Marp themes
templates.entrypoint: Select a named theme; treat base, constants, and palette CSS as support files rather than themes

templates.name: Codebytes Marp Slides Template
templates.best_for: Technical talks and code-focused Markdown slide decks
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the example deck and theme CSS files before selecting a style

templates.name: Marp Theme Wave
templates.best_for: Clean Markdown presentations using a wave-inspired Marp style
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the theme CSS and example slides before adaptation

templates.name: Academic PPT Template
templates.best_for: Academic reports and research presentations requiring an editable PowerPoint file
templates.entrypoint: Inspect assets/academic-template.pptx masters, layouts, fonts, and placeholders before use

templates.name: BIT PPT Template
templates.best_for: Authorized Beijing Institute of Technology academic and institutional presentations
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the PPTX masters, layouts, assets, and fonts before use
templates.brand_notice: Confirm authorization before using institutional logos or implying endorsement.

templates.name: PPT Report Skills
templates.best_for: Structured report decks assembled from reusable HTML slide layouts
templates.entrypoint: Inspect the repository Skill and assets/slides-templates before composing a report

templates.name: SeaSlides
templates.best_for: Browser-based presentations needing a varied collection of reusable themes
templates.entrypoint: Inspect each template directory and its theme.md before selecting a design
